exec_summary.headline: A Nature lab ran more than 11,000 AI-orchestrated steps across 20+ instruments.
exec_summary.body: AutoDNA pairs agent workflows with a multi-instrument lab stack. The paper reports 11,000+ steps and concurrent protocols completed 3.2 times faster.

exec_summary.headline: DeepMind says agentic chemistry compressed a multi-day design loop to about an hour.
exec_summary.body: Its Cheminformatics Skills run workflows through Antigravity, with six months of top-tier access offered to 10,000 scientists.

exec_summary.headline: Google's Omni 1.2 Flash turns a prompt into editable 15-second video.
exec_summary.body: Google says the model supports conversational video edits at $0.07 per second and is available in Google Vids at no extra cost.

exec_summary.headline: A hobbyist project says it ran a 284-billion-parameter model in 64 GB of RAM without a GPU.
exec_summary.body: The llama-modchip project makes its kernel patches and quantization tools public; its README reports the memory and no-GPU figures.

exec_summary.headline: OpenAI showed Codex moving from CAD and simulation into a physical prototype.
exec_summary.body: OpenAI says two people designed a hardware device in under a week, with a contract manufacturer building prototypes in under a month.
